Sieges that actually finish.
THIS MOD CHANGES ASSAULT AI, AND IT IS ON BY DEFAULT. Vanilla scales the retreat threshold by assault progress: attackers who cannot get up the walls pull back after roughly 40% losses, regroup, and try again — so a siege can rock back and forth for in-game weeks. With this mod the threshold is a flat low value, so the assault runs to a conclusion. Attackers still break off if they are genuinely destroyed (default: after losing about 75%), and the threshold is configurable. If you want vanilla assault behaviour, switch it off in MCM — every patch here has its own toggle.
It also fixes two vanilla siege bugs:
ARMY WIPED OUT ON RETREAT. Vanilla treats a failed assault as a total capture — the whole besieging army is taken prisoner or killed, and its lords respawn with a single troop. Now survivors retreat instead. A genuine wipe is still a wipe.
CRASH WHEN A PARTY JOINS A SIEGE. A vanilla NullReferenceException during the campaign tick hard-crashes the game, most often when many AI sieges are running. The exception is caught so the game keeps running. Honest trade-off: that one party does not join that siege — this hides the symptom rather than curing the cause.
Does not touch save data. No overlay. Patches only three engine methods, with no overlap with SiegeFix.
Requirements: Bannerlord v1.3.15, Harmony, ButterLib, MCM (MBOptionScreen).
